panels.description: Lina places the worn bronze Maker's Seal in Alex's palm. Their hands and the open-hand symbol dominate; leave upper space for dialogue.
Alex sets the Seal beside the purifier's registry tag while Suri's hand enters from one side and Ren's hand from the other. Do not show full additional bodies; leave the upper band clear.
The registry screen lists all five named contributors and separates attribution from exclusive claim. Keep the display unobstructed.
Suri presses the public-release control while Ren watches from beside the machine; Alex is visible only as a hand holding the Seal at frame edge. Leave upper space.

items.speaker: LINA
items.text: It records who made this. It doesn’t make you owner of us.
